Account controls

Delete your account

Gabber will provide an authenticated in-app deletion flow before its public store release.

Not active yet: The current beta does not contain a complete self-service account deletion endpoint. This page must not claim that deletion is available until the feature and support route are implemented.

Planned in-app process

  1. Open Gabber and go to Profile or Settings.
  2. Select Account, then Delete account.
  3. Confirm the phone number and complete the verification step.
  4. Review what will be deleted and submit the request.

What deletion should cover

The production deletion process should remove or de-identify the account profile and data that Gabber is not required to retain. Messages or content already delivered to other users may remain in their conversations, and limited records may be retained for fraud prevention, dispute handling, backups or legal obligations.

Business accounts

A business owner may need to resolve active orders, payments, bookings or regulatory retention requirements before all business records can be deleted.

Need assistance?

A monitored support email and a verified request procedure must be added before public launch. Until then, use only test accounts that do not contain sensitive personal information.
